references.text: The prophet Isaiah describes a day when the stars in the sky and their constellations will not shine, which mirrors the language about heavenly disturbances in Mark.
Joel prophesies about a time of cosmic disturbances, including that the sun shall be turned to darkness and the moon to blood, before the great and dreadful day of the Lord comes.
The Revelation of John describes a vision where the stars in the sky fall to the earth, which resembles the description of heavenly disturbances in Mark.
